## Common WHERE Filters

| Filter | Example | Frequency |
|--------|---------|-----------|
| `grass_date = DATE '...'` / `date "${bizTimeFormatter(...)}"` | `grass_date = DATE '2025-08-20'`, `grass_date = date "${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd', '-1d')}"` | Nearly all queries |
| `grass_region = '...'` / `grass_region IN (...)` | `grass_region = 'ID'`, `grass_region IN ('ID','MY','PH','SG','TH','TW','VN')` | Most queries |
| `operation = 1` | `operation = 1` (deduct impr) | Bidding signal extraction |
| `livestreams[0].ads_id > 0` | Direct filter on single-element access | Workflow ETL |
| `entrance IN (...)` | `entrance IN (27,28,38,39,42,48)` | Livestream entrance filter |
| `get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.pricing_type') = '...'` | `= '19'` (MAX_GMV2), `= '22'`, `= '10'` | Pricing type filter |
| `h = N` / `h >= N` | `h = 12`, `h >= 19` | Hour partition filter |
| `livestream_info.ads_id > 0` | After LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE | Multi-livestream queries |
| `rn_ver >= '...'` / `app_ver >= '...'` | Version-based filtering | TMS comparison queries |

## Common JOIN Patterns

This ODS table is primarily used with `LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE` for array unnesting and JOINed with performance tables:

```sql
-- Pattern 1: Single livestream access (most common for bidding extraction)
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_livestream_ads_tracking__reg_s0_live
-- Access fields via livestreams[0].field_name

-- Pattern 2: Explode livestreams array (TMS comparison)
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_livestream_ads_tracking__reg_s0_live
LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(livestreams) AS livestream_info

-- Pattern 3: Join with dwd_livestream_performance_di for tracking + performance data
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_livestream_ads_tracking__reg_s0_live tracking
JOIN mp_paidads.dwd_livestream_performance_di__reg_s0_live performance
  ON tracking.grass_region = performance.grass_region
 AND tracking.grass_date = performance.grass_date
 AND ... (ads_id, request_id, streamer_id, etc.)

-- Pattern 4: Join with dim_entry_point_mapping_v2 for entrance name
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.dim_entry_point_mapping_v2
  ON tracking.entrance = dim_entry_point_mapping_v2.entrance

-- Pattern 5: Join with dim_exchange_rate for currency conversion
JOIN mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live c
  ON p.grass_region = c.grass_region
 AND p.grass_date = c.grass_date

-- Pattern 6: Join old tracking with TMS tracking by unique_id
FROM old_tracking
INNER JOIN tms_tracking
  ON old_tracking.unique_id = tms_tracking.unique_id
 AND old_tracking.grass_date = tms_tracking.grass_date
 AND old_tracking.entrance = tms_tracking.entrance
 AND old_tracking.grass_region = tms_tracking.grass_region
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- Bidding signal aggregation (group by ads_id, request_id, streamer_id)
SELECT
    grass_region, grass_date,
    livestreams[0].ads_id AS ads_id,
    livestreams[0].user_id AS streamer_id,
    get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.request_id') AS request_id,
    AVG(CAST(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.pctr') AS DOUBLE)) AS pctr,
    AVG(CAST(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.pcr') AS DOUBLE)) AS pcr,
    AVG(CAST(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.target_cir') AS DOUBLE)) AS target_cir,
    AVG(CAST(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.ecpm') AS DOUBLE)) AS ecpm,
    AVG(CAST(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.aov') AS DOUBLE) / 100000) AS aov,
    AVG(CAST(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.price_coef') AS DOUBLE)) AS price_coef
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_livestream_ads_tracking__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_region IN ('ID','MY','PH','SG','TH','TW','VN')
  AND grass_date = DATE '...'
  AND operation = 1
GROUP BY grass_region, grass_date, ads_id, streamer_id, request_id;

-- TMS comparison: count mismatches by field
SELECT
    entrance,
    COUNT(*) AS total_cnt,
    SUM(IF(old_tracking.user_id <=> tms_tracking.user_id, 0, 1)) AS unequal_user_id_cnt,
    SUM(IF(old_tracking.session_id <=> tms_tracking.session_id, 0, 1)) AS unequal_session_id_cnt,
    ...
GROUP BY entrance;
```

### 1. Intermediate Value Tracker ETL (workflows/jinyang/live_ads_dashboard)

Extracts bidding signals from tracking log and joins with performance + exchange rate for live ads dashboard.

```sql
WITH tracking_log AS (
  SELECT
    grass_region, grass_date,
    livestreams[0].ads_id AS ads_id,
    livestreams[0].shop_id AS shop_id,
    livestreams[0].user_id AS streamer_id,
    get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.request_id') AS request_id,
    avg(cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.pctr') AS DOUBLE)) AS pctr,
    avg(cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.pcr') AS DOUBLE)) AS pcr,
    avg(cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.target_cir') AS DOUBLE)) AS target_cir,
    avg(cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.ecpm') AS DOUBLE)) AS ecpm,
    avg(cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.aov') AS DOUBLE) / 100000) AS aov,
    avg(cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.price_coef') AS DOUBLE)) AS price_coef,
    avg(cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.deduction_price') AS DOUBLE)) AS deduction_price
  FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_livestream_ads_tracking__reg_s0_live
  WHERE grass_region IN ('ID','MY','PH','SG','TH','TW','VN')
    AND grass_date = date "${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd', '-1d')}"
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6
)
SELECT ...
FROM tracking_log tl
JOIN performance p ON ... AND tl.ads_id = p.ads_id ...
JOIN mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live c ON ...
```

### 2. Discovery Ads Intermediate Values (workflows/jinyang.peh/live_dashboard)

Extracts bidding signals grouped by pricing_type, placement, and streamer for discovery ads models.

```sql
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    grass_date, grass_region,
    livestreams[0].user_id AS streamer_id,
    livestreams[0].ads_id AS ads_id,
    get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.request_id') AS request_id,
    cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.pricing_type') AS INT) AS pricing_type,
    cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.placement') AS INT) AS placement,
    cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.pctr') AS DOUBLE) AS pctr,
    cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.pcr') AS DOUBLE) AS pcr,
    cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.aov') AS DOUBLE) / 100000 AS aov,
    cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.streamer_type') AS INT) AS streamer_type
  FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_livestream_ads_tracking__reg_s0_live
  WHERE grass_date = date "${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd', '-1d')}"
    AND grass_region IN ('ID','TH','VN','PH','MY','TW','SG')
    AND operation = 1
)
SELECT grass_date, grass_region, pricing_type, placement, ads_id, streamer_id, streamer_type, request_id,
       avg(if(pctr > 0, pctr, 0)) AS pctrs,
       avg(if(pcr > 0, pcr, 0)) AS pcrs,
       avg(aov) AS aov
FROM base
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8;
```

### 5. Impression Duration Distribution Analysis (manual_tasks/nam.nguyentien/deduction)

Analyzes impression duration distribution by placement using timestamp difference.

```sql
SELECT placement, duration, count(1)
FROM (
  SELECT placement,
    CASE
      WHEN impression_duration / 60 <= 1 THEN '0-1min'
      WHEN impression_duration / 60 <= 5 THEN '1-5min'
      WHEN impression_duration / 60 <= 10 THEN '5-10min'
      WHEN impression_duration / 60 <= 30 THEN '10-30min'
      ...
    END AS duration
  FROM (
    SELECT placement,
           tracking_timestamp - recall_timestamp AS impression_duration
    FROM (
      SELECT placement, entrance,
             get_json_object(foo.json_data, '$.response_timestamp') AS recall_timestamp,
             timestamp AS tracking_timestamp,
             get_json_object(foo.json_data, '$.request_id') AS request_id
      FROM (
        SELECT *, EXPLODE(livestreams) AS foo
        FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_livestream_ads_tracking__reg_s0_live
        WHERE placement IN (3327,3328,3338,3337,3339,3342,3348)
          AND grass_date = DATE '2024-11-19'
          AND grass_region = 'ID'
          AND operation = 1
      )
    )
  )
) GROUP BY placement, duration;
```

### 6. MPC Raw Data Extraction (Python/PySpark, workflows/bo.wangwb/live_ads_mpc)

Extracts tracking and performance data for MPC (Model Predictive Control) live ads bidding.

```python
sql_raw = """
SELECT
    tracking.request_id,
    tracking.ls_session_id,
    tracking.ads_id,
    tracking.streamer_id,
    tracking.price_coef,
    cast(performance.ls_session_duration AS BIGINT) AS ls_session_duration,
    performance.imp, performance.order, performance.broad_gmv,
    performance.imp_timestamp, performance.order_timestamp
FROM (
    SELECT
        get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.request_id') AS request_id,
        livestreams[0].ls_session_id AS ls_session_id,
        livestreams[0].ads_id AS ads_id,
        livestreams[0].user_id AS streamer_id,
        avg(cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.price_coef') AS DOUBLE)) AS price_coef
    FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_livestream_ads_tracking__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = '{grass_region}'
      AND grass_date = '{date}'
      AND get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.pricing_type') = '19'
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
) tracking
JOIN (...) performance
  ON tracking.request_id = performance.request_id
 AND tracking.ls_session_id = performance.ls_session_id
 AND tracking.ads_id = performance.ads_id
 AND tracking.streamer_id = performance.streamer_id
"""
```

## Write Lineage (生产血缘)

This is an **ODS (Operational Data Store)** table. Data is ingested from the livestream ads tracking SDK directly into HDFS Parquet files, not produced by an INSERT OVERWRITE SQL workflow.

- **Data Source:** Livestream ads tracking SDK client events -> HDFS Parquet ingestion
- **HDFS Path:** `hdfs://R2/projects/data_paidadsmart/hdfs/prod/logs/ods_log_livestream_ads_tracking__reg_s0_live`
- **Partition Strategy:** Partitions are registered via `MSCK REPAIR TABLE` or `ALTER TABLE ADD PARTITION` per `(grass_region, grass_date, h)`.
- **DDL Workflow Paths:**
  - `data_paidadsmart/workflows/data_warehouse/workflow/create_new_table/Data Processing/create_livestream_ads_tracking_reg_table` - DROP + CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE (full region table)
  - `data_paidadsmart/workflows/data_warehouse/workflow/create_new_table/Data Processing/create_livestream_ads_tracking_region_split_table` - CREATE region-split tables (id/sg/th/vn/my/ph/tw_s0_live)

备注：`mp_paidads` 数据库下有 region-split 版本的该表（如 `ods_log_livestream_ads_tracking__id_s0_live`），它们指向同一个 HDFS 基础路径，按 `grass_region=` 子目录分区。`_reg_s0_live` 全量表是它们的全集，额外包含 `grass_region` 分区列。

### Downstream Tables (this table feeds into):

| Downstream Table | Workflow Path | Transform |
|-----------------|---------------|-----------|
| `mkplpaidads_brand_ads.live_ads_intermediate_value_tracker_v1` | `mkplpaidads_brand_ads/workflows/jinyang/live_ads_dashboard/` | AVG() bidding signals, JOIN with dwd_livestream_performance_di + dim_exchange_rate |
| `mkplpaidads_discovery_ads.liveads_intermediate_values_v0` | `mkplpaidads_discovery_ads/workflows/jinyang.peh/live_dashboard/perf_tracking/` | AVG() by pricing_type/placement/streamer, JOIN with performance |
| TMS diff tables | `data_paidadsmart/workflows/playground/shengyu.wang/tms_diff/` | LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE, field-by-field comparison with TMS |

| Metric | Expression | Source |
|--------|-----------|--------|
| pctr | `avg(cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.pctr') AS DOUBLE))` | livestreams[].json_data |
| pcr | `avg(cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.pcr') AS DOUBLE))` | livestreams[].json_data |
| target_cir | `avg(cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.target_cir') AS DOUBLE))` | livestreams[].json_data |
| ecpm | `avg(cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.ecpm') AS DOUBLE))` | livestreams[].json_data |
| aov (USD) | `avg(cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.aov') AS DOUBLE) / 100000)` | livestreams[].json_data |
| price_coef | `avg(cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.price_coef') AS DOUBLE))` | livestreams[].json_data |
| deduction_price | `avg(cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.deduction_price') AS DOUBLE))` | livestreams[].json_data |
| pricing_type | `get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.pricing_type')` | livestreams[].json_data |
| placement (within json_data) | `get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.placement')` | livestreams[].json_data |
| streamer_type | `cast(get_json_object(livestreams[0].json_data, '$.streamer_type') AS INT)` | livestreams[].json_data |
| streamer_type_class | `case when streamer_type in (2,3) then 'kol' else 'seller' end` | livestreams[].json_data |
| predicted_aov (USD, with exchange rate) | `aov / exchange_rate` | derived: aov / dim_exchange_rate.exchange_rate |
| impression_duration | `timestamp - recall_timestamp` | timestamp - get_json_object(foo.json_data, '$.response_timestamp') |
